reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): item 4 = 06 (1 byte), item 6 = 01, item 8 = 0500 are read at their own length and written at :2, :3, :3 (0006, 000001, 000500); set length 18 -> 1c, checksum recomputed. Input values chosen for this vector; derived without an engine by a standalone program.
